title: Suno launches Visuals: turn songs into lyric videos, album art and 15-second AI video clips

sources.name: Suno Visuals product page and FAQ

kept.claim: Suno announced and launched Visuals on 17 November 2026. This is the original announcement date, so the story is not older than the sources imply.
kept.evidence: Source 0: blog dated Nov 17, 2026 ('today... Meet Visuals'). Source 1: 'Announced on 17 November'. Source 3: dated November 17, 2026; 'went live on the web on Tuesday (November 17)'.

kept.claim: Visuals can create lyric videos, album art and video clips, including a clip re-imagined from a user's photo.
kept.evidence: Source 0: 'Lyric videos... Album art... A photo re-imagined into an inspiring video clip.' Source 1: 'create lyric videos, album artwork and video clips'. Source 3: lists lyric videos, album art and video clips built from a user's own photo.

kept.claim: Video clips are up to 15 seconds long.
kept.evidence: Source 0: 'make clips up to 15 seconds long'. Source 1: 'video clips of up to 15 seconds'. Source 3: 'generating clips of up to 15 seconds'.

kept.claim: Users drag a song from their Suno library into the Visuals tab to make clips.
kept.evidence: Source 0: 'Drag any song from your library into the Visuals tab'. Source 3: 'works from a song in the user's Suno library'.

kept.claim: Clips can be extended, edited and re-prompted with text.
kept.evidence: Source 0: 'extend, edit and re-prompt with text'. Source 1: 'edit and extend videos using text prompts'. Source 3: 'extended, edited, or re-prompted with text'.

kept.claim: The video model follows the song's structure, picks up on lyrics and lip-syncs to them.
kept.evidence: Source 0: 'Video clips follow your song's structure, pick up on your lyrics and lip sync'. Source 1: 'respond to a song's structure and lyrics... lip-sync to lyrics'. Source 3 quotes Brody to the same effect.

kept.claim: Users can start from Suno's original characters or upload their own original image.
kept.evidence: Source 0: 'original characters... Or start with an original image of your own'. Source 1: 'select characters from Suno's library or upload images'. Source 3: 'original characters Suno has created, or upload an original image'.

kept.claim: Visuals credits are separate from song credits, and credit packs can be bought at suno.com/pricing/visuals.
kept.evidence: Source 0: 'Visual credits are purchased separately from song credits'. Source 1: 'separate credit system'. Source 2 FAQ: Visual credits are for videos and images, song credits for songs. Source 3: 'separate credit system'.

kept.claim: The credit cost of a Visual depends on factors such as clip duration and quality. Users choose between 'fast' and 'standard' quality, and fast costs fewer credits.
kept.evidence: Source 2 FAQ: cost depends on duration and quality; fast costs fewer credits than Standard. Source 3: credits depend on duration and quality, with 'fast' and 'standard' modes.

kept.claim: Pro and Premier subscribers get a limited number of Visual credits to try for a limited time. Any user can buy credit packs, and purchased credits don't expire.
kept.evidence: Source 2 FAQ: 'For a limited time, Pro and Premier subscribers will have a limited number of Visual credits'; purchased credits 'don't expire'. Source 3: same, 'which do not expire'.

kept.claim: Visuals is powered by H3 Move, a model based on MiniMax's H3 that Suno optimized with added protections and safeguards. Source 0, the blog post, does not state this.
kept.evidence: Source 1: 'powered by H3 Move... developed by... MiniMax, based on its H3 model'. Source 2 FAQ: 'The model is called H3 Move, based on H3 from MiniMax'. Source 3: Visuals runs on H3 Move, based on MiniMax's H3.

kept.claim: Exports can be made at different durations and aspect ratios: 9:16, 1:1 and 16:9.
kept.evidence: Source 2: 'Select your clip's duration and aspect ratio'; image alt text 'exported at 9:16, 1:1 and 16:9'. Source 3: product page shows a single clip at 9:16, 1:1 and 16:9.

kept.claim: Suno added text and visual filters to block uploads and prompts that try to depict specific artists, public figures, copyrighted works and IP.
kept.evidence: Source 0: 'suite of new text and visual filters intended to block uploads and prompts...'. Source 1 and Source 3 quote or restate it.

kept.claim: Generated videos and images are checked against Community Guidelines, using the same filters plus third-party tools, before the user sees them.
kept.evidence: Source 0: check happens 'before the Visual is shown to the user'. Source 1: 'checked against Suno's Community Guidelines before being displayed'. Source 3: 'screen generated videos and images... before users see them'.

kept.claim: Suno continues to work with Audible Magic, ACRCloud and Musixmatch to block uploads containing copyrighted audio.
kept.evidence: Source 0 names all three. Source 1 says the same. Source 3 says the same and adds lyrics.

kept.claim: Embedded watermarks are applied to Visuals before they can be shared off-platform.
kept.evidence: Source 0: 'embedded watermarks to Visuals before they can be shared off-platform'. Source 1: videos 'contain hidden watermarks before they are shared outside the platform'. Source 3: will embed watermarks before sharing outside Suno.

kept.claim: Availability, version B (conflicting): Visuals launched on web on 17 November, and the iOS and Android versions were to follow in the coming weeks.
kept.evidence: Source 1: 'Mobile applications for iOS and Android are expected to follow in the coming weeks.' Source 3: 'went live on the web... Suno says iOS and Android versions will follow in the coming weeks.' This conflicts with Source 0.

kept.claim: Jack Brody is Suno's Chief Product Officer and wrote the announcement.
kept.evidence: Source 0 byline: 'By Jack Brody, Chief Product Officer'. Source 3: 'Suno Chief Product Officer Jack Brody'.

kept.claim: MiniMax is being sued for copyright infringement by Disney, Universal and Warner Bros Discovery. A US federal judge declined to dismiss the case, which centres on its Hailuo AI video platform.
kept.evidence: Source 1: 'facing copyright infringement lawsuits brought by Disney, Universal and Warner Bros Discovery... judge declined to dismiss'. Source 3: filed September 2025; on May 22 Judge Blumenfeld refused to throw out the case.

kept.claim: Visuals follows Suno's Speech (beta) tool, launched on October 1, 2026, for spoken audio such as poems and meditations.
kept.evidence: Source 0: 'launched Speech in October'; the related-posts list shows 'Introducing Speech (beta)... Oct 1, 2026'. Source 3: launched in beta on October 1.

dropped.claim: Availability, version A (Suno's own post): Visuals launched on web, iOS and Android at the same time.
dropped.evidence: Source 0: 'We're launching today on web, iOS, and Android.'
